name: Ash Legion — jump-pack arm v1 · 1.2 scale review · cloth layer · clarity tidy
notes:
Experimental Ash Legion variation: short mantle, integrated idle jump pack, exposed exhausts, thigh-length front vestment. Body and arm share 41x58 frame and shoulder [18,19]. Feet row 54. Separate glow. Not gameplay-tested or approved. Cloth and pack are static body artwork; no cloth physics added.
Jarred 1 Nov: needs native-pixel cleanup to match the equipment family. Palette noise, block grouping and near/far distinction remain outstanding. This candidate changes ONLY game_scale to 1.2 and review notes; original pixels, frames and sockets retained. All four body parts must use the same scale. Rendered at 1 and 1.2 with current main game rig; not battle/play tested or approved. Do not treat the render comparison as final art. Cloth moved to the Cloth layer (greys; the game colours it per faction) on 1 Nov 2026.
Clarity tidy: reduced armour/cloth shade count, neutralised tan speckles and merged isolated interior value flecks into neighbouring planes. Isolated warm material flecks surrounded by cloth are moved into the cloth layer. Cloth remains a separate neutral-grey faction-tinted layer. Far leg material slightly darker. Combined body/cloth silhouette, emissive/trim layers, original frame counts/FPS, scales and ALL anchors retained. Torso hip remains [21,31] as moved by Jarred. No socket or proportion changes. Draft pending game-scale review.

frames.note: Idle fit-test variation. No engine flame baked into artwork.
